title: CCXVIII. The Reſurrection of CHRIST. Luke xxiv. 34.

segments.text:
1
YES, the Redeemer roſe;
The Saviour left the Dead;
And o'er our helliſh Foes
High rais'd his conqu'ring Head:
In wild Diſmay
The Guards around
Fell to the Ground,
And ſunk away.

2
Lo, the angelick Bands
In full Aſſembly meet,
To wait his high Commands,
And worſhip at his Feet:
Joyful they come,
And wing their Way
From Realms of Day
To ſuch a Tomb.

3
Then back to Heav'n they fly,
And the glad Tidings bear:
Hark! as they ſoar on high
What Muſick fills the Air!
Their Anthems ſay,
"Jeſus who bled
"Hath left the Dead;
"He roſe to-day".

4
Ye Mortals, catch the Sound,
Redeem'd by him from Hell;
And ſend the Eccho round
The Globe on which you dwell:
Tranſported cry,
"Jeſus who bled
"Hath left the Dead
"No more to die".

5
All-hail, triumphant Lord,
Who ſav'ſt us with thy Blood!
Wide be thy Name ador'd,
Thou riſing, reigning God!
With Thee we riſe,
With Thee we reign,
And Empires gain
Beyond the Skies.
